name: Ossuvane
flavor: Warden post at a cold-running array; the draw ledger hangs on the truce-stone.

name: Kelvarrin
flavor: Bare seep lines on a north shoulder; the pool is a dozen paces of black water.

name: Threnn Comb
flavor: Half-wild fins flood the canyon with fog at wind-hour; travelers navigate by its chord.

name: Ummaris
flavor: Stone lids over the catch; homesteads cluster a ridge away and walk in for market.

name: Isk Vaal
flavor: A lone slab weeping onto flat sand; the crawler's comb-sails are sighted from it first.

name: Quellith
flavor: The array runs cold and true; the cistern shaft rings when the wind is right.

name: Dessarin Weep
flavor: Mats ridged square to the wind, every ridge dripping to one basin.

name: Vulla Catch
flavor: Stretched awnings over the pool; a crawler market ring worn into the sand beside it.

name: Nhar Ellu
flavor: A hairline crack in bedrock sweats enough for one herd at a time.

name: Sillik Face
flavor: A vertical weep-face alive with weep-mice licking the film; the pool is an afterthought.

name: Orrindal
flavor: A leaking array made a hanging marsh; blade-reeds stand thigh-deep in it.

name: Tessavorn
flavor: Walled windbreaks and a Compact ledger-house; draw is counted, never refused.

name: Kharrow Spire
flavor: Bone-and-vane chimes hang on the cold face; no one has ever camped here.

name: Ulm Sedrath
flavor: Fins the height of towers, still turning to the wind; the pool below is deep and blue-shaded.

name: Vorsalla
flavor: The Compact's sealed grotto; servo-vents breathe at wind-hour and the ledger is law.

name: Ilvanne
flavor: Two weep-lines meet in a cleft and pool in a bowl the burrak keep dug.

name: Ghesh Ammar
flavor: Cracked cistern walls bleed sideways; the marsh below hums with dew-smoke swarms.

name: Ennoril
flavor: Flat ground, a lidded pool, and homestead vaporators in a ring a mile out.

name: Tal Quarrow
flavor: Low stone near the terminator; the weep here is the coldest and the slowest.

name: Vessik
flavor: An array of only five fins, every one still sound; a small sure pool.

name: Marrukomb
flavor: The seep lines run in parallel like teeth; from the ridge the face reads as a comb.

name: Ossik Ring
flavor: A silent machine in a ring of bleached bone; the sand has taken the shaft.

name: Zhurr
flavor: A single black streak on a single standing stone, marked on every crawler chart.

name: Ashvaneth
flavor: Fins run wild; whole afternoons vanish into ground-cloud and the pools overflow.

name: Orrekh
flavor: Silent watering ground; a cairn of vane-chimes marks that the Tribes have passed.

name: Selvarrin
flavor: A sealed dome at the base of the rock; the warden's vents open only to the wet wind.

name: Quenth
flavor: Stone lids of unknown make over a pool nobody claims; everyone maintains them.

name: Ithravane
flavor: Runs cold and true; the chord of its fins is the clearest on the Horn.

name: Nakkar Crest
flavor: Crest-line weep; the pool sits in a stone bowl at the top of the world.

name: Hurrimal
flavor: A leaking array on low ground; the marsh spreads wider each year than the pool.

name: Cindravel
flavor: Black streaks on the whitest stone in the Belt; the signature mark at its plainest.

name: Ulvakarr
flavor: High array that never falters; pilgrims from three biomes drink here in rotation.

name: Dhessa Comb
flavor: Awnings of dewsilk over the catch; the rare crawler that stays, stays here.

name: Ferrovane
flavor: Verdigris fins leak into a hanging garden that drips onto the pool below.

name: Immeloth
flavor: Low hills catch a thin wind; the pool is shallow and warm and always crowded.

name: Skarrun
flavor: Helix tents ring a dead machine on a hot mesa; they buy their water by the tanker.

name: Yeth Ammu
flavor: A seep in the lee of one boulder; the ring of green is ten paces across.

name: Kessarel
flavor: Caravan lids and a camp ring; the bead-chain road turns here toward the Belt.

name: Rhon Tavar
flavor: A shaded cleft in red stone; the burrak dig has outlived the burrak.

name: Ghurrok Ring
flavor: Dry ring around a silent array; the fins still turn, and comb nothing.

name: Karrabesh
flavor: The rare settled Jawa oasis: a sealed grotto, a permanent market, and everyone notes it.

name: Sarrowen
flavor: Flat, hot, and improbable; a stone lip weeps into a pool ringed by scrub.

name: Vrettik
flavor: A cracked cistern leaks a green ribbon a hundred paces downslope.

name: Ammavane
flavor: The fins sing a minor chord; the pool under them is cold enough to ache.

name: Terrin Weep
flavor: Coldest weep in the Belt; the mats here are thick as felt.

name: Ollun Catch
flavor: Awnings and a lidded shaft; three homesteads within sight, none on the water.

name: Vaskerrin
flavor: A warden post on a true-running array near the terminator; the ledger is old.

name: Hessamund
flavor: A weep-face a hundred paces long; the pool at its foot is a black mirror.

name: Quorrath
flavor: The array leaks upward through split fins; a mist-garden grows on the fins themselves.

name: Brennivar
flavor: Fan-dancers hold their displays here; the rattle carries a mile downwind.

name: Ithlune
flavor: A stone lid over a pool nobody owns; pilgrims repair it as a courtesy.

name: Vorrakesh
flavor: Two burrak wallows joined into one broad shallow; the tirbak herds favor it.

name: Cindrakomb
flavor: Highest running array in the Belt; aching-cold water, verdigris fins.

name: Zoth Pallanne
flavor: A gilded servo-dome; the water inside is free, the gate is not, and the Hutt lives here.

name: Merrowfin
flavor: Blade-plants stand in ranks on the shade side; the pool is small and always full.

name: Tannivar
flavor: Flat ground under a single lid; the crawler market circuit's southern stop.

name: Essaline
flavor: Its twin sits across the line; this one keeps the wilder crowd.

name: Ghalluk
flavor: Sand-buried stone that weeps into a bowl; found by ear, not by eye.

name: Norrin Seep
flavor: Low stone, slow weep; the moss mats are the greenest near the terminator.

name: Kellumar
flavor: The oldest array on the map, by the ledgers; it leaks a hanging marsh into a gorge.

name: Sarrevane
flavor: Runs cold and true in near-dusk light; the fins glow at the tips.

name: Umbrevesh
flavor: A seep in blue shadow; the pool never sees direct sun.

name: Corrindath
flavor: Windbreak walls and a warden's hut; draw is written, and the truce-stone is polished.

name: Rhessuk
flavor: A crawler waypoint: the last reliable pool before the open sand.

name: Tallaquen
flavor: A stone tooth in the sand-sea; its pool is the size of a cart-bed.

name: Ilsevane
flavor: Fog-wild; the canyon fills to the brim at wind-hour and every comb drinks.

name: Shaddrek
flavor: Impassable stone; the Tribes reach it by routes nobody else knows.

name: Verrinal
flavor: A cold face thick with ridged mats; drip-tips feed a pool the shape of a blade.

name: Kaddoth
flavor: Overhangs cut by hand, long ago; nobody remembers whose.

name: Ossendrel
flavor: A true-running array in impassable stone; heard, rarely reached.

name: Thurrakan
flavor: Dead ring high on the Horn; a Helix camp with more instruments than tents.

name: Emmavane
flavor: A leaking array; the marsh has climbed the fins and made them green.

name: Rukhessa
flavor: A weeping cliff; the pool lies in a burrak dig at its foot.

name: Lowthess
flavor: Nearly flat, nearly hot; a lone stone slab weeps enough for a thin green ring.

name: Karrunveth
flavor: Weep-lines like strung wire down impassable rock; the pool is unreachable but seen.

name: Aeshvorn
flavor: The highest fog-wild array; its cloud rolls off the summit like a slow wave.

name: Dhurrilene
flavor: Lidded pool and a homestead ring; marriages are made here at wind-hour.

name: Vellomar
flavor: An Imperial garrison squats on the pool and meters its own water; despised past politics.

name: Skorrath
flavor: High hot stone; the weep is thin and the ring is scrub, but it never fails.

name: Zarrukh Ring
flavor: A dead array on a mesa top; the bones ringing it are all of one kind.

name: Oon Sarrik
flavor: One stone, one streak, one pool; the tirbak drink it dry and it refills by dusk.

name: Ellumen
flavor: A crawler-chart waypoint; the market is a day long and then gone.

name: Khessrun
flavor: Silent fins on hot stone; the pool went with the machine.

name: Verrigal
flavor: A Verge seep on flat ground; the green ring is the only color for miles.

name: Ossumel
flavor: Caravan lids and a truce-stone heaped with tokens; a crawler stops every circuit.

name: Kessukar
flavor: Blackstar cache under a stone lid; a team watering here quietly means a hunt nearby.

name: Thallumar
flavor: Low stone in the sand; the pool is warm and the ring is tight.

name: Ithekk
flavor: A leaking array in the sand-sea; the marsh is a miracle nobody explains.

name: Ruvannak
flavor: A shaded cleft; fan-dancers display here in the cool of wind-hour.

name: Nessavane
flavor: Cold and true near the terminator; the shaft rings like a bell.

name: Orrimund
flavor: A long weep-face; mats so thick the drip is a steady hiss.

name: Tessikar
flavor: A seep in a stone bowl; ssurr crests flash at the rim at wind-hour.

name: Wennoral
flavor: Warden windbreaks; the ledger here is the oldest the Compact keeps.

name: Ilmarrow
flavor: Leaking fins made a hanging marsh; dew-smoke swarms thick as cloth.

name: Quessadrin
flavor: The weep-face curves like a bowl; the pool at its foot catches its whole breath.

name: Kharrivane
flavor: True-running; the chord is low and the water is the coldest in the Belt.

name: Ambrossek
flavor: A burrak well under a cold face; the elder dug it deep enough to last.

name: Ferrinesh
flavor: Overhangs of stone laid by no one anyone remembers; kept by everyone.

name: Sollumvane
flavor: Fog-wild; the whole basin drinks at once when the fins run.

name: Vashkerel
flavor: A cleft weeps from both walls; the pool is narrow and black and deep.

name: Ennavorn
flavor: Homesteads a ridge away; the pool is where the young come to court.

name: Sarrukesh
flavor: A lone stone at the Fever Wood's edge; the green ring here is thicker than any other.

name: Ollavane
flavor: A warden post on a running array; the draw is tallied on the fins themselves.

name: Heskumar
flavor: A short weep-face with a wide pool; a favorite of the tirbak herds.

name: Torrinel
flavor: A dewsilk awning the crawler leaves behind each circuit; the market ring is permanent.

name: Vhelloth
flavor: Flat ground at the Wood's margin; the seep is slow but the green ring is wide.

name: Arrukesh
flavor: One stone in the sand-sea, weeping onto its own shadow.

name: Nhessul
flavor: Marked on the crawler charts as a two-day pool; it fills faster than that.

name: Ommarik
flavor: A leaking array on flat sand; the marsh it made is a green scar visible from the ridges.

name: Skerrivane
flavor: The fins turned to rust and stopped; bones ring the dry basin.

name: Yallumar
flavor: A cleft in red rock; the burrak dig is fresh and the pool is new.

name: Ulloresh
flavor: Caravan lids over a pool on the bead-chain road; a cairn every mile out.

name: Zenniver
flavor: A stone tooth weeping a thin streak; the green is a single ring of blades.

name: Tarrukel
flavor: A Blackstar rendezvous; nothing is cached, and the discipline is iron.

name: Ammeril
flavor: Near-terminator array, running true in perpetual half-light.

name: Corrovesh
flavor: Cold stone in blue shadow; the mats are ridged like corduroy and never dry.

name: Ilkessa
flavor: A weep-face with a burrak wallow at its foot; the pool is broad and shallow.

name: Thennoral
flavor: Lidded pool; the homesteads hold their rituals here at wind-hour.

name: Ossimarr
flavor: Leaking fins; the hanging marsh is where the dewsilk weavers gather cocoons.

name: Sedrakesh
flavor: A sealed grotto at the base of the rock; the Compact's largest ledger-house.

name: Vellarin
flavor: Two seep-lines cross on the face and pool below in a black lens.

name: Kessivar
flavor: The animal haven: every pilgrim beast on the dayside drinks here in rotation, and the wardens watch.

name: Rhennivane
flavor: A curving cliff that combs the wind into a pool the ssurr use for their displays.

name: Ulvamund
flavor: Windbreak walls of stacked stone; kept by whoever is passing.

name: Tarrivesh
flavor: True-running; the chord is two notes and the pool is never low.

name: Nimmoral
flavor: A cleft weep; weep-mice by the thousand on the face.

name: Sarrivane
flavor: Fog-wild; the array's cloud fills the cleft and pours out the mouth.

name: Hollunar
flavor: A weep-face under a natural overhang; the pool never sees sun.

name: Quorrivesh
flavor: Warden windbreaks; the truce-stone here is a slab of pure verdigris.

name: Ekkumar
flavor: A stone in the sand-sea; the pool is a hand's depth and a herd's width.

name: Vrass Ullun
flavor: The hottest pool on the crawler charts; the market here is held at wind-hour only.

name: Thossarek
flavor: Weeps from a buried shelf; the green ring outlines the stone below the sand.

name: Ashkorrin
flavor: High array, cold and true; the pool is blue in the shade of its own fins.

name: Ithravesh
flavor: Tribal chimes on every ledge; the weep is thin and the reverence is thick.

name: Ommavane
flavor: Leaking fins made a hanging marsh on the cliff; it drips into the pool in a steady curtain.

name: Kellorath
flavor: Stone lids of ancient cut; the pool is small and the shade is deep.

name: Vorrinesh
flavor: A weep-face with a hundred parallel streaks; the comb made plain.

name: Sessarune
flavor: Impassable stone; the pool is glimpsed from the pass and never reached.

name: Rakkavane
flavor: Fog-wild; the canyon floods with cloud and the mirrik swarms come out.

name: Ennekesh
flavor: A small true-running array; the water is sweet and the chord is high.

name: Ullavorn
flavor: A stone bowl at the top of a cleft; the weep fills it and the wind keeps it.

name: Zhol Marrane
flavor: A perfumed servo-dome; the Hutt bathes in what pilgrims drink, just inside the law.

name: Tessavane
flavor: Leaking array; the marsh is small and the blade-reeds are enormous.

name: Kharrosh
flavor: Impassable; the pool is heard from the pass by its drip-echo.

name: Ithrakel
flavor: Low hills; awnings of dewsilk and a crawler market that lasts three days.

name: Sorrukesh
flavor: A high cold face; the mats are blue in the shade and the pool is black.

name: Aelvane
flavor: High array; runs true, and its chord is the one the pilgrims sing.

name: Ossurath
flavor: The uplink: a dead ring on the summit, a silent machine still listening, and the Helix camped around it.

name: Verrukan
flavor: A weep in a cleft; fan-dancers hold their displays on the rim.

name: Ithamund
flavor: A leaking array on the cliff; the hanging marsh glows green in blue shade.

name: Quellorath
flavor: Stone lids over a pool on the pass; kept by every traveler who uses it.

name: Nasserine
flavor: A cold face weeping into a burrak well; the ring is scrub, then green, then water.

name: Ravvakesh
flavor: True-running; a small pool, a clear chord, and a truce-stone heaped with tokens.

name: Umberekh
flavor: A weep-face in a north cleft; the pool is deep enough to swim.

name: Sollarrin
flavor: Fog-wild; the cloud spills over the pass and the far side drinks too.

name: Kellivesh
flavor: Homesteads a ridge off; the pool is their market-day ground.

name: Orravane
flavor: Leaking array; the marsh has climbed the fins and dew-smoke nests in them.

name: Dhessaroth
flavor: Chimes on the face and no footprints; the Tribes water in silence here.

name: Thurrivane
flavor: Dead ring; the machine went silent and the pool went with it.

name: Ammukesh
flavor: Flat ground under lids; the crawler circuit's northern stop.

name: Tessulmar
flavor: Flat and warm; one stone weeps into a pool ringed by blades.

name: Ollumar
flavor: A stone shelf on flat ground; the green ring is wider than the pool by ten times.

name: Ferrukel
flavor: A leaking array on flat ground; the marsh is a green sheet on the sand.

name: Sarrekesh
flavor: Low hills; the weep is thin, the crowd is thick.

name: Vullumar
flavor: Lids and windbreaks; the homesteads come for market and marriage.

name: Fevrakesh
flavor: At the Fever Wood's edge; the ring of green is thick and strange.

name: Nessorath
flavor: A cold weep-face; the pool at its foot is a black lens in blue shade.

name: Ithravorn
flavor: Runs true near the terminator; the fins glow at the tips at wind-hour.

name: Corrukesh
flavor: A curving weep-face; the mats are ridged and the pool is round.

name: Sallivane
flavor: Warden windbreaks on flat ground; the ledger is kept in the shade of the lids.

name: Ummaresh
flavor: A weep-face under an overhang; the pool is cold and never sees sun.

name: Rhossumar
flavor: Leaking array on flat ground; the marsh is a green sheet with the fins standing in it.

name: Tallivesh
flavor: One stone shelf weeps into a pool ringed by blades; fan-dancers display at its rim.

name: Quessumar
flavor: Flat ground and one stone; the pool is the size of a hall floor.

name: Orrukesh
flavor: A true-running array on flat ground; the pool is broad and cold.

name: Vennorath
flavor: A cleft weep; weep-mice on the face and dew-smoke over the pool.

name: Skessumar
flavor: A shaded cleft in hot stone; the pool is warm and the ring is tight.

name: Zharrukel
flavor: Blackstar rendezvous under a stone lid; nothing cached, iron truce.

name: Ullukesh
flavor: Hot stone in the north sand; the weep is thin but the burrak dig is deep.

name: Thessumar
flavor: A leaking array; the marsh is a green ribbon down the slope.

name: Verrumesh
flavor: A Verge seep on flat ground; the pool is warm and the ring is wide.

name: Hollumar
flavor: Lids and windbreaks; homesteads a mile out, and the pool is their courting ground.

name: Sessukel
flavor: A crawler waypoint on the Verge; the market is one day and then gone.

name: Ammuresh
flavor: A small true-running array; the chord is high and the pool is sweet.

name: Torrukel
flavor: One stone shelf weeps into a pool on the Verge's edge; blades ring it.

name: Ossivane
flavor: Dead ring on the Horn; the fins still turn and comb nothing.
